svg.title: Centerline tracing: actual native curve output
svg.desc: Four 128 by 128 pixel fixtures, each shown as the exact source raster and as actual traceRaster geometry over the same raster at one quarter opacity. All images are displayed at 1.5 times their original size. Teal curves and white anchors are returned by the engine; orange anchors mark shared branch junctions. Stored node counts include coincident endpoints belonging to separate native contours. Source hashes and complete options are in the companion metrics JSON. These examples do not claim universal accuracy or recovery of source stroke thickness.
svg.text: Centerline tracing: actual native curve output
Source pixels, fitted Béziers and editable anchors · 128 × 128 px fixtures shown at 1.5×
Monochrome · threshold 128 · fit tolerance 0.75 working px · corners preserved · noise filter off

g.aria-label: Curved stroke: 4 stored nodes, 2 curved spans
Thick crossing: 10 stored nodes, 0 curved spans
Closed ring: 22 stored nodes, 22 curved spans
Loop with a tail: 10 stored nodes, 8 curved spans
g.text: 1 closed + 1 open contour · one shared junction

svg.text: Stored node counts include coincident endpoints on separate contours. Curved spans exclude collinear controls.
Centerlines use a chosen uniform output width; source thickness and pen pressure are not recovered.
